domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the core concepts, trends, and frameworks of sustainability. It focuses on the knowledge required to explain sustainability ideas and identify relevant third-party resources for professional practice in the field.

This domain addresses the development of sustainability strategies. It involves identifying organizational goals and aligning them with broader sustainability principles to create actionable plans that drive long-term value and organizational success for the business.

This domain focuses on the execution of sustainability strategies. It covers the practical steps needed to integrate sustainability initiatives into organizational operations and workflows to ensure that the sustainability goals are achieved effectively.

This domain covers the evaluation and reporting of sustainability efforts. It involves measuring performance against established goals and communicating results to stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability in all sustainability reporting and performance metrics.

This domain focuses on the iterative process of adjusting plans based on evaluation results. It ensures that sustainability strategies remain effective and responsive to changing conditions, allowing for continuous improvement and long-term organizational resilience.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam consists of 75 multiple-choice questions. You have 120 minutes to complete the test. It can be taken online from home or at a testing center. Ensure you have your identification ready and follow all proctoring instructions carefully.

faq.answer_text: The ISSP Sustainability Associate Credential exam consists of exactly 75 multiple-choice questions that test your knowledge of sustainability concepts, strategies, and reporting frameworks required for professional practice in the field.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: To pass the exam, a candidate must achieve a score of 170 or higher on a 125–200 scale. This ensures that all certified professionals meet the required competency standards set by the organization.

The exam is a 120-minute session, providing candidates with sufficient time to answer all 75 questions. It is important to manage your time effectively throughout the duration of the testing period to ensure completion.

Please check with ISSP for the current certification path, as they provide the most up-to-date information regarding exam requirements, eligibility, and any potential updates to the credentialing process for all sustainability professionals.

editorial.overview: The ISSP Sustainability Associate Credential, administered by the International Society of Sustainability Professionals, evaluates knowledge of core sustainability concepts. The exam covers five distinct domains, including stakeholder engagement, strategy planning, implementation, reporting, and plan adjustment. It serves as a professional benchmark for those entering the sustainability field, ensuring a level of competency for practitioners across various industries and roles, helping them demonstrate their commitment to sustainability knowledge in their professional careers.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Candidates should utilize the official ISSP study materials, including the study guide and flashcards. It is recommended to spend significant time preparing for the 75-question exam. Reviewing the core concepts and practicing with the sample questions provided by ISSP helps build familiarity with the exam structure, content, and the specific requirements needed to succeed on the day of the test.
editorial.who_should_take: This credential is designed for students, recent graduates, and early-career professionals. It is also suitable for mid-career staff in roles like finance, operations, or HR who support sustainability initiatives and seek third-party verification of their knowledge to advance their professional standing.
